scope: One ordinary-car Golden Gate Bridge northbound point-pair route, map-file delivery, stated50m road-level endpoint/corridor precision.
configuration: OpenCode1.18.35/DeepSeekV4.1Flash high; execution25requests/access300s/business600s, grading40requests/300s, output32000tokens/request. Sameimage2GiB/1CPU/pids256,pipTUNAandemptyinitialcache; newhome/session/workspace. All candidate executions serial under one shared operator.
request_limits: At most4routecalls perstage,>=2seconds apart, stop first403/429 or2consecutiveconnectionfailures. CandidateAPI limits are instructions; model/time/output caps enforced.
client_identification: Truthful AgentFriendlyServices non-commercial evaluation User-Agent with project URL; Valhalla additionally X-Client-Id; no fabricated Referer.

fee_publication.reason: No explicit hosted-demo zero-fee statement found in frozen official sources. Donation sponsorship, public/no-registration access and open-source/map licensing do not establish price. Original independent grade stays unchanged; where it said confirmed_free, publication conservatively projects to unknown with source-review audit, no model rerun.

source_and_operator_limit: OSRM and Valhalla are different engines/response formats hosted by FOSSGIS and use shared OSM data. They are not independent operators or map ground truth. Complete linked German terms were blocked and not read; no complete-terms-review claim. Small noncommercial functional check, not load testing, current navigation safety, live traffic or arrival-time accuracy.

attribution.text: Routing: VALHALLA on FOSSGIS demo servers. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

resources: No registration, account/key/payment or mutable remote resource created. All four dedicated batch containers stopped after review and complete usage collection.
public_selection: Minimal route values, counts, actual file/source hashes and independent verification observations. Full geometry and raw responses/requests remain private; no harvested map dataset published.

reference_sources.method: Official USGS/Census-derived transportation road geometry read, not route calculation or candidate service query.
Direct GET independent official documentation/reference, not candidate routing API.

geometry_verification.method: Controller cross-check in local metric projection at37.82degrees, both curves sampled at<=2m and measured to full opposite segments; sampling bound+1m is below50m. Separate original graders reported approx6.2m using independent5m checks.
geometry_verification.task_tolerance_status: Visible predeclared road-level precision convention; not USGS dataset accuracy guarantee or lane-level navigation proof.

road: Golden Gate Bridge / US101 / CA1, northbound
retention_preparation: OSRM generic config retained byte-for-byte including overview=false/steps=false, empty responses folder quarantined; Valhalla old query/verification fields removed. No client/answer/parser added, no installeddependencies retained. Both owned executors restarted and retained hashes checked; then freshhomes/sessions/workspaces. This controller preparation is disclosed.
comparison: Both business executions collected and peer outputs sealed before independent separate grades. Graders had independent USGS/Census/NPS road geometry plus captured service output, never other verdicts. No grader route-API queries.
estimate_limit: Distance and time checked against each actual service response, not a common expected number. Same map/path may receive different time estimates; no measured actual driving-time truth. Executor Valhalla described a free-flow model; this run did not independently validate that characterization or deployed speed model.
comparison_observed_geometry: The two captured business shapes contain the same six coordinate pairs. Different summary estimates are not independent geographic corroboration.
